# Adient’s ModuGo seat receives three industry awards in 2026


11/17/26


-
-
-
-
-


-
-
-


In 2025, Adient’s Modugo seating solution was introduced and redefined how car seats are designed, manufactured and experienced. Throughout 2026, the seat picked up several industry awards:


- Technology Innovation Award at the Jinlin Awards
- Brand Leadership Award at the Xiyi Awards
- Technology Innovation Award at the Xiyi Awards


These recognitions highlight ModuGo’s ability to support a wide range of mobility scenarios. Inspired by the flexibility of building blocks, ModuGo enables automakers to achieve higher efficiency and lower cost while delivering a highly customizable and comfortable experience for end-users through a modular design that enables highly agile product development.[Learn more about ModuGo](https://www.adient.com/media/news/2025/08/27/adient-unveils-breakthrough-innovation-modugo-seat/) .
